sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Artistic Branch, Stable

system.description:
You mold clay, earth or another inorganic earthen substance into the shape of two centipedes of your description that seems to come to life temporarily listening to your commands known as a Clay Dragon into a space of your choice within range.

The Clay Dragon has the listed statistics found on its stat block at the end of this clan and uses your Ninjutsu attack bonus or Save DC when an effect calls for it. You can command them as an Action or Bonus action. You can have one Clay Dragon active at a time.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.

| Clay Spider / Small Clay Construct, unaligned / Armor Class 10 + your ninjutsu ability modifier / Hit Points 10 + 10 for every rank above C-Rank / Speed 30 ft. / | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | / | STR | +0 | +3 | CON | +0 | +3 | WIS | +0 | +0 | / | DEX | +0 | +3 | INT | -5 | -5 | CHA | -5 | -5 | / Damage Immunities Acid, Poison, Psychic. / Condition Immunities All Mental, All Sensory, Stunned, Exhaustion / Skills Stealth / Senses Relies on Caster senses / Shock Weakness. If this creature takes Lightning damage it cannot perform its Detonate attack, until the end of its casters next turn. It also cannot perform its Detonate attack while it has the Shocked condition. / Silent Scurry. When this creature is summoned, make a Stealth check using your highest jutsu modifier vs any hostile creature that can see you. On a success, then Clay Spider is Undetected by creatures that do not have Chakra sight or Chakra sense. / Purpose to BOOM. Once summoned this creature has 1 minute before it self Detonates. If it cannot Detonate after this 1-minute duration, it dispels itself. / Attacks / Scurry. The Spider takes the Dash and Disengage action as part of this action. / Grab. The Spider attempts to grab onto a creature and hold on to it with sacrificial intent. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save the creature has the spider hold on to it. The creature can attempt to pull the spider free by making a Strength saving throw, pulling the spider free on a success. / Detonate. The Spider detonates, filling a 5-foot radius. All creatures in the radius takes force damage on a failed Dexterity saving throw or half as much on a success based on the rank the Spider(s) were summoned at. A creature the spider is grabbing makes their save at disadvantage. If more than one spider is Detonating and the same creature is within more than 1 radius, they make a single saving throw, but increase the damage they take by +2d6 for each Clay Spider explosion radius they are in. / D-Rank/C-Rank: 3d6 / B-Rank/A-Rank: 4d6 / S-Rank: 5d6 |

| Clay Bird / Large Clay Construct, unaligned / Armor Class 12 + your ninjutsu ability modifier / Hit Points 40 + 10 for every rank above C-Rank / Speed 45 ft. Flying Speed / | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | / | STR | +2 | +4 | CON | +3 | +7 | WIS | +0 | +0 | / | DEX | +4 | +8 | INT | -5 | -5 | CHA | -5 | -5 | / Damage Vulnerability Lightning / Damage Immunities Acid, Poison, Psychic. / Condition Immunities All Mental, All Sensory, Stunned, Exhaustion / Senses Relies on Caster senses / Flying Mount. The Clay Birds primary purpose is to be a flying mount. A creature of your choice can mount the Clay Bird. When it does, replace the creatures movement with the Clay Birds. The Clay Bird moves with the mounted creature. If you are mounted to the Clay Bird, you cannot command it to move separate from you unless you dismount by spending 5 feet of your normal movement. Attacks targeting the mounted Creature does not harm the Clay Bird and attacks targeting the Clay Bird does not harm the mounted creature. A mounted creature can spend its reaction to switch targets causing either themselves or the Clay Bird to interpose an attack targeting the other. Effects that target an area affects both the Clay Bird and mounted creature as individuals. / Shock Weakness. If this creature takes Lightning damage it cannot perform its Detonate attack, until the end of its casters next turn. It also cannot perform its Detonate attack while it has the Shocked condition. / Purpose to BOOM. Once summoned this creature has 1 minute before it self Detonates. If it cannot Detonate after this 1-minute duration, it dispels itself. / Attacks / Ram. If the Clay Bird flies in a straight line for at least 30 feet it can perform the Ram attack. All creatures in a straight line after the bird has moved at least 30 feet must succeed a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. / Detonate. The Clay Bird detonates in a beautiful incendiary display, filling a 10-foot radius centered on it. All creatures in the radius takes force damage on a failed Dexterity saving throw or half as much on a success based on the rank the Clay Bird was summoned at. If more than one Clay Bird is Detonating and the same creature is within more than 1 radius, they make a single saving throw, but increase the damage they take by +2d8 for each additional Clay Bird explosion radius they are in. / D-Rank/C-Rank: 4d8 / B-Rank/A-Rank: 5d8 / S-Rank: 6d8 |

| Clay Centipede / Large Clay Construct, unaligned / Armor Class 14 + your ninjutsu ability modifier / Hit Points 30 + 15 for every rank above B-Rank / Speed 40 ft, 60 ft climb / | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | / | STR | +2 | +4 | CON | +3 | +7 | WIS | +0 | +0 | / | DEX | +4 | +8 | INT | -5 | -5 | CHA | -5 | -5 | / Damage Vulnerability Lightning / Damage Immunities Acid, Poison, Psychic. / Condition Immunities All Mental, All Sensory / Senses Relies on Caster senses / Shock Weakness. If this creature takes Lightning damage it cannot perform its Detonate attack, until the end of its casters next turn. It also cannot perform its Detonate attack while it has the Shocked condition. / Purpose to BOOM. Once summoned this creature has 1 minute before it self Detonates. If it cannot Detonate after this 1-minute duration, it dispels itself. / Bug Bomb. When this creature falls to 0 hit points it uses its Detonate attack as a reaction. / Attacks / Multiattack. The Clay Centipede can attack 2 times with its pincers. / Pincers. Melee Weapon Attack: reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d6 + 4 piercing damage. / Body Wrap. The Centipede attempts to grapple onto a creature and hold it in place with sacrificial intent. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save the creature is Grappled by the centipede. The creature can attempt to free itself by spending its Action to; or at the end of its turn; make a Strength saving throw, breaking the grapple on a success. / Detonate. The Clay Centipede detonates in a beautiful incendiary display, filling a 10-foot radius centered on it. All creatures in the radius takes force damage on a failed Dexterity saving throw or half as much on a success based on the rank the Clay Centipede was summoned at. If more than one Clay Centipede is Detonating and the same creature is within more than 1 radius, they make a single saving throw, but increase the damage they take by +2d6 for each additional Clay Centipede explosion radius they are in. / B-Rank/A-Rank: 6d6 / S-Rank: 8d6 |

Attacks targeting the mounted Creature must instead target the Dragon and attacks targeting the Clay Dragon does not harm the mounted creature. Effects that target an area affects only the Clay Dragon. / Shock Weakness. If this creature takes Lightning damage it cannot perform its Detonate attack, until the end of its casters next turn. It also cannot perform its Detonate attack while it has the Shocked condition. / Purpose to BOOM. Once summoned this creature has 1 minute before it self Detonates. If it cannot Detonate after this 1-minute duration, it dispels itself. / Attacks / Multiattack. The Clay Dragon can attack 2 times with its Tail. / Tail. The Clay Dragon casts Explosion Release: Clay Missiles at C-Rank as if you had cast it, using your Ninjutsu attack bonus, save DC or ability Modifier when needed. / Detonate. The Clay Dragon detonates in a beautiful incendiary display, filling a 10-foot radius centered on it. All creatures in the radius takes force damage on a failed Dexterity saving throw or half as much on a success based on the rank the Clay Dragon was summoned at. / A-Rank: 8d8 / S-Rank: 12d8 |
